answer: Whether agents trade lotus seeds, trellis designs, or voyage plans, each seller must lock a fixed bond before accepting a job, and that bond stays locked until the dispute window closes. An auditable failure to deliver forfeits the bond. Creating extra identities therefore creates no free capacity: an attacker running 1,000 sellers must fund 1,000 bonds, tie up that capital throughout each job, and risk losing it on fraudulent orders.
